qa_pairs.question: Where can users view the resource usage of individual members within their group on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Metrix portal, within the "Account Statistics" section (for both CPU and GPU accounts), users can view the resource usage by each individual member of their group.

qa_pairs.question: What type of resource usage information is available for individual group members under the "Account Statistics" section?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Account Statistics" section provides information on the resource usage, including CPU and GPU, for each individual user within a group.
